summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Ltd (MMA.INC) furnished on Form 6-K a press release and corporate presentation dated September 1, 2026. The filing highlights platform growth: 389 paying academies (~260% growth since January 2025), 108,000 registered students, 28,000 monthly active users, and US$21 million in run-rate annualized payments. It also discloses an August 2026 US$4 million private placement at US$1.00 per share, a ~160% premium to the August 19, 2026 close. No transaction, board action, or strategic event is announced; the filing is purely an investor-relations update.
